summary: Acer Aspire 5 15 (A515-57GQ) with Intel Core i7-1165G7 processor, NVIDIA GeForce MX330 graphics card, 16GB RAM, and 512GB SSD. The system is experiencing thermal throttling due to inadequate cooling system.
detected_fault: Inadequate cooling system causing thermal throttling
suggested_solution: Replace the cooling fan or upgrade to a more efficient cooling system
